plans.planTitle: Spend management and net suite rollout
plans.summary:
Here are our kickoff notes for Apex Logistics. Set up a 3-phase corporate card and fuel spend onboarding plan:

---
CLIENT KICKOFF CALL NOTES: APEX LOGISTICS
Date: Nov 10, 2026
Attendees: 
- Marcus Vance (VP of Operations, Apex Logistics - marcus@apexlogistics.com)
- Rachel Adams (Head of Finance, Apex Logistics)
- Alex Rivera (Implementation Lead, Volopay)

Target Go-Live Date: December 20, 2026
Scope & Objectives:
Apex Logistics operates a regional and interstate fleet with 85 commercial drivers. They are experiencing ~12% monthly spend leakage due to paper fuel receipts, lost reimbursement slips, and non-fuel convenience store purchases on personal cards. They need an automated spend management rollout with merchant category locks and accounting sync.

Key Decisions & Action Items from Kickoff:

PHASE 1: Fleet Roster & Spend Policy Setup (Target: Nov 25, 2026)
- Apex team needs to upload the master roster of 85 drivers, including vehicle registration numbers and state license IDs.
- Volopay team will configure Merchant Category Code (MCC) locks — strictly lock cards to MCC 5541 (Service Stations / Fuel) and disable non-fuel convenience retail.
- Volopay underwriting must approve and activate the $250k revolving fleet credit line.
- Apex Finance (Rachel) needs to confirm multi-tier manager approval thresholds: any expense over $350 requires automated dispatcher sign-off.

PHASE 2: Card Logistics & ERP Accounting Sync (Target: Dec 8, 2026)
- Volopay operations will bulk-dispatch 85 physical contactless fleet cards via FedEx Priority with individual tracking numbers.
- Apex IT/Finance will connect their QuickBooks Online production tenant via OAuth 2.0.
- Volopay implementation engineer will map Chart of Accounts (COA) to default fuel account #6240 and toll account #6250.
- Run a 2-way dummy sync test with 10 simulated fuel transactions to ensure clean GL journal entry posting.

PHASE 3: Driver Rollout, Telematics & Go-Live (Target: Dec 20, 2026)
- Volopay to conduct a 30-minute live webinar training for dispatchers and fleet managers on instant card freeze/unfreeze controls.
- Apex drivers to download the mobile app and verify mobile numbers for card activation.
- Configure mandatory odometer and vehicle ID prompts on the POS terminal whenever a fuel pump card is swiped.
- Final executive sign-off from Marcus Vance and full cutover to live fleet spending.
---
